timeline.summary: Appointed Sarvesh Kumar Adukia as Chief Executive Officer effective 27 July 2026.
High Court dismissed Metso claim and ordered release of ₹5.52 Cr deposited by Mcnally Bharat with accrued interest.
Q1FY27 results showed revenue flat at ₹15.05 Cr but PAT loss narrowed to ₹25.27 Cr from ₹230.26 Cr YoY due to lower finance and operating costs.
NCLT Kolkata passed order on 12 June 2026 directing UCO Bank and three JVs to refund ₹24.25 Cr to Mcnally Bharat with 9% interest, recognised in Q1FY27 results
Trading approval received for 3,33,33,334 equity shares issued on preferential basis under Resolution Plan, effective from September 1, 2026
AGM held on September 25, 2026, with all resolutions passed via e-voting

McNally Bharat Engineering disclosed nil default on loans and unlisted debt securities as of 30 September 2026, noting full settlement under Resolution Plan but pending No Dues Certificates from banks.

upcoming_events.description: Closure of Register of Members and Share Transfer Books from 19th September 2026 to 21st September 2026 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of the 63rd AGM
63rd Annual General Meeting to be held on Friday, 25th September 2026 through Video Conference / Other Audio Visual Means (VC/OAVM)
